crossRefs.note: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.
Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

people.name: Ezra
people.line: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Then Ezra arose, and made the chiefs of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they would do according to this word. So they swore.
translations.bsb: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests, Levites, and all Israel take an oath to do what had been said. And they took the oath.
translations.kjv: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
